title: 2.7 Basic Colors
unit_title: Unit 2: Places, Objects, Numbers, and Colors
unit_outcome: Recognize common surroundings and identify, count, and describe concrete objects without using untaught location language.
lesson_title: Unit 2: Places, Objects, Numbers, and Colors
goal: Recognize, hear, and say six basic colors and use It is color for a clear color field.
grammar_function: It is red/blue/etc. Object color descriptions are deferred to 2.8.
prerequisite: 2.6 number recognition and earlier it identity frame.
speaking_outcome: Repeat all six color words in short It is color sentences.
